partners.mechanism_chain: SNCA (HGNC:11172) —DISRUPTS→ alpha-synuclein aggregation (GO:0000326); alpha-synuclein aggregation (GO:0000326) —LEADS_TO→ Dopaminergic neuron loss (HP:0007320); JAK2 (HGNC:6358) —INCREASES→ JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP403); JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP403) —DECREASES→ Hematopoietic stem cell differentiation (GO:0007550); Hematopoietic stem cell differentiation (GO:0007550) —LEADS_TO→ Acute myeloid leukemia (MONDO:0018874). Mutations in SNCA lead to alpha-synuclein aggregation, causing dopaminergic neuron loss in Parkinson disease. Aberrant activation of the JAK-STAT signaling pathway due to mutations in JAK2 (and other shared genes like FLT3, DNMT3A, RUNX1) impairs hematopoietic stem cell differentiation, leading to acute myeloid leukemia. The convergence point is the dysregulation of cellular differentiation and signaling pathways, which are fundamental processes in both neuronal and hematopoietic systems.

partners.mechanism_chain: SNCA (HGNC:11173) —LEADS_TO→ Parkinson disease (MONDO:0011562); SNCA (HGNC:11173) —INCREASES→ Neuroinflammation (HP:0012531); EIF2AK2 (HGNC:3554) —DISRUPTS→ Integrated Stress Response (GO:0036463); Integrated Stress Response (GO:0036463) —DECREASES→ Axonal degeneration (HP:0004949); Integrated Stress Response (GO:0036463) —LEADS_TO→ Leukoencephalopathy, developmental delay, and episodic neurologic regression syndrome (MONDO:0030035); Neuroinflammation (HP:0012531) —LEADS_TO→ Axonal degeneration (HP:0004949).
